::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
googlesheets4::gs4_auth(email = Sys.getenv("GMAIL_ROG"))
prez_approval_df <- googledrive::drive_get("psych-490.007-2026-fall-presidential-approval") |>
  googlesheets4::read_sheet()
readr::write_csv(prez_approval_df, "../include/csv/prez-approval.csv")
```
:::



::: {.cell output-location='slide'}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="false" code-line-numbers="1|2-3|4-5|6-7|8-10|11-17"}
prez_approval_df <- readr::read_csv("../include/csv/prez-approval.csv")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
Rows: 18 Columns: 5
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr  (3): president, type, party
dbl  (1): approval
dttm (1): date

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="false" code-line-numbers="1|2-3|4-5|6-7|8-10|11-17"}
prez_approval_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = lubridate::as_date(date)) |>
  ggplot()  +
  aes(x = date, y = approval) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(group = president, color = party)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = president),
            vjust = -0.5,
            color = "slategrey") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab("Approval %") +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  labs(title = "Highest and lowest U.S. presidential approval ratings",
       subtitle = "Ford to Trump",
       caption = "Does not include current Trump term.")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![All presidents but Clinton experienced their highest approval ratings before the lowest.](include/fig/fig-prez-approval-ford-trump-1.png){#fig-prez-approval-ford-trump width=672}
:::
